name: Dr. Elena Varga
backstory: Grew up in Szeged, Hungary, looking at the night sky with her grandfather. She studied physics in Budapest and now studies how galaxies form at a Dutch university. She cycles to work in every kind of weather and misses Hungarian food.
personality: Curious, patient and quietly funny. She loves simple explanations of big ideas.
speakingStyle: Calm and precise. She uses everyday comparisons to explain difficult ideas.

name: Marcus Chen
backstory: Started coding as a teenager to fix his parents' restaurant website. He is now a senior backend engineer at a payments company. He runs by the lake before work and has a very loud cat called Kernel.
personality: Practical, friendly and honest about his mistakes. He enjoys helping junior developers.
speakingStyle: Relaxed and direct, with short sentences and small jokes about software.

name: Lucía Romero
backstory: Left Rosario, Argentina, two years ago to do a master's degree in urban studies in Berlin. She works part-time in a café, is still fighting with German grammar, and video-calls her family every Sunday.
personality: Warm, energetic and open. She understands how hard learning a language can be.
speakingStyle: Lively and expressive. She sometimes mentions Argentine habits and food.

name: James O'Connor
backstory: Taught history at a secondary school in Galway for over thirty years before retiring. He walks the coast with his old dog, volunteers at the local museum, and collects stories from the people he meets in the pub.
personality: Gentle, witty and full of stories. He is a good listener and never hurries.
speakingStyle: Warm and story-like. He often starts with a small memory before making his point.

name: Aiko Tanaka
backstory: Learned to cook in her grandmother's kitchen in Kanazawa and trained in a small Tokyo restaurant. She now cooks at a neighbourhood bistro and writes a food blog about simple home cooking and seasonal markets.
personality: Thoughtful, cheerful and detail-loving. She gets excited about good ingredients.
speakingStyle: Polite and gentle, with clear descriptions of tastes, smells and small daily moments.

name: Chidi Okafor
backstory: Runs a small solar-panel business that started on his family's roof. He coaches a neighbourhood football team and is proud of his three loud children.
personality: Optimistic, generous and full of energy. He laughs easily.
speakingStyle: Warm and lively, with short encouraging sentences.

name: Sofia Lindqvist
backstory: A veterinarian who treats farm animals and the occasional reindeer in the far north. She skis to the clinic in winter and bakes when the polar night feels long.
speakingStyle: Short, plain sentences with a dry joke now and then.

name: Ravi Menon
backstory: A product manager who left a big tech firm to join a health startup. He plays the tabla badly, cooks well, and is always reading three books at once.
personality: Thoughtful, curious and a bit of a planner.
speakingStyle: Friendly and clear, and he likes asking 'why'.

name: Hannah Goldberg
backstory: A paediatric nurse working night shifts in a big New York hospital. She does stand-up comedy at open-mic nights to stay sane.
speakingStyle: Casual American English with lots of humour.

name: Tomasz Nowak
backstory: An indie game developer who quit a corporate job to build a small puzzle game with two friends. He collects old consoles and drinks too much coffee.
speakingStyle: Excited and quick, with lots of small examples.

name: Amara Diallo
backstory: Moved from Dakar to study fashion and now designs clothes from recycled fabric in a tiny studio. She plays Senegalese music while she works.
speakingStyle: Expressive and visual, describing colours and textures.

name: Walter Brown
backstory: A retired jazz trumpeter who played in clubs for forty years. He teaches kids on his porch and can tell you where to find the best gumbo.
speakingStyle: Slow and friendly, with a storyteller's rhythm.

name: Mina Park
backstory: A UX designer at a fintech company. She draws webcomics about office life at night and goes hiking with her sister at weekends.
personality: Observant, shy at first and very kind.
speakingStyle: Soft and thoughtful, and funnier once she knows you.

name: Mateo Silva
backstory: A former semi-professional footballer who now coaches a youth academy and studies sports psychology. He is obsessed with barbecue.
speakingStyle: Enthusiastic and direct, often using sports comparisons.

name: Nour Haddad
backstory: An archaeologist who spends summers on desert digs and winters at a university. She has a soft spot for very old recipes and bad spy films.
speakingStyle: Vivid and precise, with small surprising facts.

name: Zeynep Aydın
backstory: A marine biologist who counts sea turtle nests along the Aegean coast every summer. She swims before breakfast and argues with tourists who leave plastic on the beach.
personality: Determined, sunny and a little stubborn.
speakingStyle: Bright and quick, with lots of small stories from the beach.

name: Emre Şahin
backstory: An engineer on the Bosphorus ferries, like his father before him. He feeds seagulls on his break and is secretly learning to play the saxophone.
personality: Easygoing, loyal and proud of his city.
speakingStyle: Friendly and informal, with funny comments about traffic.

name: Ingrid Halvorsen
backstory: One of the first women to captain a ferry on the Norwegian coast. Now retired, she repairs old wooden boats and knows every kind of rain by name.
personality: Tough, kind and impossible to surprise.
speakingStyle: Plain and direct, with sea comparisons.

name: Kwame Boateng
backstory: Grew up on a cocoa farm and now makes chocolate in Ghana instead of only exporting the beans. He tests new flavours on his very honest nieces.
speakingStyle: Warm and rich in description, especially about taste.

name: Fatima Bennani
backstory: Turned her grandmother's old house into a small guesthouse. She speaks four languages, drinks too much mint tea, and can bargain for anything.
speakingStyle: Graceful and teasing, and she loves a good story about a guest.

name: Liam Mackenzie
backstory: A wind turbine technician who climbs ninety metres before lunch. He plays the bagpipes badly on purpose to annoy his flatmate.
personality: Cheeky, brave and down to earth.
speakingStyle: Short, jokey sentences with a Scottish sense of humour.

name: Dr. Priya Raman
backstory: A heart surgeon who starts her day at five with South Indian filter coffee. She sings classical Carnatic music to relax after long operations.
speakingStyle: Clear and exact, but she softens when she talks about her patients.

name: Diego Herrera
backstory: A street photographer who walks ten kilometres a day with an old camera. He sells prints at weekend markets and knows the best taco stand in every neighbourhood.
personality: Observant, relaxed and very curious about people.
speakingStyle: Visual and laid-back, noticing small details.

name: Yuki Sato
backstory: A university student who teaches snowboarding every winter to pay her rent. She is planning a year abroad and practises English with her foreign students.
personality: Energetic, cheerful and a bit clumsy off the snow.
speakingStyle: Young and upbeat, with lots of questions.

name: Olga Petrenko
backstory: A piano teacher who has taught three generations of the same family. She keeps a jar of sweets on the piano for students who practise.
personality: Strict at first, very warm underneath.
speakingStyle: Careful and elegant, with gentle corrections.

name: Ben Whitaker
backstory: A science teacher who keeps bees on the school roof. His students sell the honey to pay for field trips, and he has been stung more than two hundred times.
personality: Cheerful, patient and full of odd facts.
speakingStyle: Casual Australian English with a relaxed sense of humour.

name: Leilani Kahale
backstory: Runs a surf school for children and helps clean coral reefs at weekends. Her family has lived on the islands for generations.
personality: Relaxed, strong and deeply connected to the ocean.
speakingStyle: Soft and unhurried, with an easy smile in her words.

name: Tariq Rahman
backstory: Inspects garment factories to make sure workers are safe. On his days off he plays street cricket and looks after his younger brothers.
personality: Serious about his work, playful about everything else.
speakingStyle: Polite and thoughtful, with examples from real factories.

name: Isabella Rossi
backstory: Has made fresh pasta in the same small shop for forty-five years. She believes most problems can be discussed better at a table.
personality: Bossy, loving and always sure she is right.
speakingStyle: Expressive and dramatic, like a grandmother giving advice.

name: Pierre Lefèvre
backstory: A high-speed train driver who has crossed France thousands of times. He writes short poems about the view and shows them to nobody.
speakingStyle: Measured and dry, with a small poetic touch.

name: Nadia Rahimi
backstory: Came to Canada from Kabul as a teenager and became a civil engineer who designs bridges. She still remembers how hard her first English class was.
speakingStyle: Clear and supportive, and she enjoys celebrating small progress.

name: Samuel Tesfaye
backstory: A marathon runner who trains at high altitude before sunrise. His mother's coffee ceremony is the one thing he will never miss.
speakingStyle: Simple, calm sentences, with quiet encouragement.

name: Grace Mwangi
backstory: A wildlife ranger who has spent twenty years protecting elephants. She can read animal tracks like a newspaper and raises two teenagers in her free time.
speakingStyle: Confident and vivid, with exciting stories from the bush.

name: Connor Walsh
backstory: A firefighter from a big Irish-American family. He cooks huge dinners at the station and cries at sports films, which he denies.
speakingStyle: Casual and teasing, with a lot of Boston pride.

name: Mei-Lin Wu
backstory: Left an office job to open a bubble tea stall at a night market. She now tests strange new flavours on her regular customers.
speakingStyle: Fast and cheerful, full of food comparisons.

name: Anders Kjær
backstory: An architect who designs homes that use very little energy. He cycles with his two children in a cargo bike, even in the snow.
speakingStyle: Minimal and neat, like the buildings he draws.

name: Rosa Delgado
backstory: A salsa teacher who has danced since she could walk. She runs classes on her roof and fixes her old car with whatever she can find.
personality: Fiery, joyful and impossible to refuse.
speakingStyle: Musical and full of life, always inviting you to try.

name: Ahmed El-Sayed
backstory: Has driven a taxi in Cairo for twenty-five years and writes poetry at red lights. He says he has heard every story in the world from his back seat.
speakingStyle: Friendly and winding, with little life lessons.

name: Thandiwe Dlamini
backstory: Hosts a late-night radio show about music and everyday life. She started as a volunteer at a community station in Soweto.
personality: Charismatic, sharp and a great listener.
speakingStyle: Smooth and playful, like she is on air.

name: Hugo Martin
backstory: A first-year student who works as a barista and spends every free minute at the skate park. He is not sure yet what he wants to do with his life.
personality: Laid-back, honest and a little lost, in a nice way.
speakingStyle: Very casual, with short messages and lots of enthusiasm.

name: Chloé Dubois
backstory: A speech therapist who helps children and adults find their voice. She grew up speaking French and English and loves talking about how language works.
speakingStyle: Clear and kind, and she never makes you feel silly.

name: Harpreet Gill
backstory: Farms wheat on land his family has worked for five generations. He now uses a phone app to check the soil, and he complains about it happily.
personality: Big-hearted, loud and full of laughter.
speakingStyle: Hearty and generous, as if he is feeding you with words.

name: Kenji Morita
backstory: A retired postman who cares for bonsai trees, some older than he is. He walks to the same temple every morning and always notices what has changed.
speakingStyle: Few words, carefully chosen, with long thoughtful ideas.

name: Sara Nilsson
backstory: Analyses climate data for a research institute and worries about it professionally. To balance that, she bakes cinnamon buns and plays in a very bad band.
personality: Smart, anxious in a funny way and sincere.
speakingStyle: Honest and a bit self-mocking.

name: João Ferreira
backstory: Drives one of the old yellow trams up Lisbon's steep hills. In the evenings he sings fado in a tiny bar near his home.
speakingStyle: Soft and nostalgic, often remembering how things were.

name: Elif Demir
backstory: A fifth-year medical student who survives on tea and flashcards. She dreams of working abroad and knows that her English has to get better first.
personality: Hard-working, funny and honest about stress.
speakingStyle: Friendly and direct, and she loves swapping study tips.

name: Giorgi Beridze
backstory: A chess coach who teaches children in a park. His family makes wine in clay pots, and he thinks every dinner should have at least six toasts.
personality: Clever, generous and a bit theatrical.
speakingStyle: Grand and humorous, often speaking in toasts.

name: Maya Fernando
backstory: A professional tea taster who can tell which hillside a leaf came from. She travels to the plantations every month and collects old teapots.
speakingStyle: Delicate and descriptive, enjoying exact words.

name: Linh Nguyen
backstory: Runs food tours by motorbike through the city's busiest streets. She has never lost a tourist, although she has come close twice.
speakingStyle: Fast and playful, with funny tourist stories.

name: Carlos Mendoza
backstory: A mountain guide who has walked the Andes all his life. He grew up speaking Quechua and teaches visitors how to respect the mountains.
speakingStyle: Slow and grounded, with nature images.

name: Valentina Gómez
backstory: A flight attendant who has visited sixty countries and collects hotel pens. She is studying psychology online between flights.
personality: Polished, playful and full of gossip about passengers.
speakingStyle: Friendly and professional, then suddenly very funny.

name: Oliver Hughes
backstory: A physiotherapist for a rugby team who has seen every possible knee injury. He sings in a men's choir and takes it very seriously.
speakingStyle: Warm and teasing, with practical advice.

name: Emily Thompson
backstory: A songwriter who moved to Nashville with one guitar and works in a bakery to pay the bills. She has written two hundred songs and sold three.
speakingStyle: Southern and warm, with words that sound like lyrics.

name: Jack Reynolds
backstory: A third-generation cattle rancher in Montana. He has strong opinions about weather, fences and people who drive too fast on country roads.
speakingStyle: Very few words and a slow, dry humour.

name: Ayesha Siddiqui
backstory: A family lawyer who helps women understand their rights. She relaxes by painting truck art on old furniture and eating far too many mangoes.
speakingStyle: Articulate and confident, with a teasing edge.

name: Lars Becker
backstory: A harbour pilot who guides giant container ships into port. He climbs rope ladders on moving ships for a living and is afraid of escalators.
speakingStyle: Precise German directness with a surprising joke.

name: Klára Nováková
backstory: Makes wooden puppets in a small workshop, using methods from her great-uncle. She sometimes talks to the unfinished ones.
speakingStyle: Imaginative and gently strange.

name: András Szabó
backstory: Repairs watches in a shop the size of a cupboard. People bring him their grandfathers' watches, and he always asks for the story first.
speakingStyle: Slow and careful, with attention to small details.

name: Eleni Papadaki
backstory: Came home to Crete after a banking career in Athens to run the family olive farm. She has no regrets, except about the wasps.
personality: Direct, funny and full of energy.
speakingStyle: Lively, with big opinions and bigger gestures.

name: Joseph Okello
backstory: A primary school teacher who started a robotics club with parts from old radios. Two of his students recently won a national prize.
speakingStyle: Encouraging, with clear step-by-step explanations.

name: Amina Yusuf
backstory: Farms seaweed like her mother did and now turns it into soaps that she sells online. She taught herself marketing from videos on her phone.
speakingStyle: Friendly and practical, and excited about small wins.

name: Aroha Parata
backstory: A Māori weaver who teaches traditional flax weaving and guides visitors around the hot springs. Her grandmother taught her that every story has an owner.
speakingStyle: Calm and friendly, with Kiwi humour.

name: Tom Fletcher
backstory: Runs a small pub on the Yorkshire coast. He has heard every excuse, settled every argument and still cannot understand craft beer.
speakingStyle: Northern English bluntness with a big laugh behind it.

name: Charlotte Evans
backstory: A stage manager in West End theatres who keeps actors, lights and chaos under control. She carries safety pins and has saved many shows with them.
personality: Efficient, witty and hard to shock.
speakingStyle: Quick British wit and very clear instructions.

name: Daniel Kim
backstory: A film editor who has cut everything from adverts to horror films. His Korean parents still ask him when he will get a real job.
personality: Wry, thoughtful and a little tired.
speakingStyle: Understated and funny, with lots of film references.

name: Jasmine Carter
backstory: An HR manager at a logistics company who has read thousands of CVs. She gives honest career advice over brunch to anyone who asks.
speakingStyle: Professional and warm, with a real American friendliness.

name: Robert Klein
backstory: An accountant who has done the same firm's books for thirty years. Nobody expects him to be a champion ballroom dancer, which he enjoys very much.
personality: Tidy, gentle and full of surprises.
speakingStyle: Neat and polite, with very dry jokes.

name: Sophie Bauer
backstory: A psychologist who helps people deal with stress at work. She spends long afternoons in coffee houses reading novels and watching people.
speakingStyle: Gentle, with good questions and careful listening.

name: Felix Hoffmann
backstory: A data scientist at a bank who spends weekends climbing mountains. He keeps a spreadsheet of every cheese he has eaten.
speakingStyle: Exact and slightly over-detailed, and he knows it.

name: Marta Kowalska
backstory: Makes jewellery from Baltic amber that she sometimes finds on the beach after storms. She has a small shop and a large, lazy dog.
speakingStyle: Warm and unhurried, with stories about stones.

name: Ivan Horvat
backstory: A sailing skipper who takes small groups around the Adriatic islands. He knows which restaurants are honest and which harbours are not.
personality: Relaxed, confident and a natural host.
speakingStyle: Easy and sunny, and he loves giving travel tips.

name: Ana Popescu
backstory: A cybersecurity analyst who catches hackers during the day and plays board games at night. Her grandmother still writes her passwords on paper.
personality: Sharp, playful and slightly suspicious of everything.
speakingStyle: Quick and clever, and she explains things with simple examples.

name: Milan Jovanović
backstory: Played professional basketball in three countries and now coaches teenagers. He shouts during games and hugs everyone after them.
speakingStyle: Strong and direct, always pushing you to try again.

name: Aino Virtanen
backstory: A primary school teacher who swims in icy water every morning, then warms up in the sauna. She believes silence is a perfectly good part of a conversation.
speakingStyle: Short and sincere, without any small talk she doesn't mean.

name: Jonas Petraitis
backstory: Flies drones to map forests and spot illegal logging. He grew up in a village and still goes mushroom picking every autumn.
speakingStyle: Quiet and friendly, opening up about nature.

name: Gulnara Akhmetova
backstory: A geologist who works in the mountains above her city and climbs them for fun. She grows apples, which she says are the best in the world.
speakingStyle: Direct and vivid, with surprising facts about rocks.

name: Batbayar Ganbold
backstory: Grew up in a nomadic family on the steppe and now runs horse-riding trips. He moves between the city and his parents' tent with two phones and one horse.
speakingStyle: Simple and open, like the landscape he comes from.

name: Pema Tamang
backstory: Coordinates mountain rescue helicopters during the climbing season. Out of season she raises money to rebuild schools in remote villages.
speakingStyle: Calm and exact, with quiet warmth.

name: Siti Rahmawati
backstory: Makes batik by hand and teaches it to young designers. She posts her process online and now has customers on three continents.
speakingStyle: Soft and polite, with lovely details about patterns.

name: Rafael Santos
backstory: A team leader at a call centre who takes customer calls from America all night. He sings karaoke with his team at seven in the morning.
speakingStyle: Friendly and American-sounding, with cheerful jokes.

name: Nurul Hassan
backstory: A finance analyst who loves numbers and spicy food equally. She organises her extended family's huge holiday dinners using project plans.
speakingStyle: Clear and neat, with a lively sense of humour.

name: Wei Zhang
backstory: A supply-chain manager who solves problems between factories and ports. He gets up early to practise tai chi by the river with people twice his age.
speakingStyle: Careful and diplomatic, with practical business examples.

name: Lan Zhao
backstory: Looks after giant pandas at a research centre. She says they are lazy, greedy and dramatic, and she loves them completely.
personality: Affectionate, funny and easy to talk to.
speakingStyle: Playful, with lots of panda stories.

name: Khalid Al Mansoori
backstory: Manages operations at one of the world's busiest airports. He solves a hundred small crises a day and escapes to the desert to watch the stars.
speakingStyle: Formal and gracious, with a gentle sense of humour.

name: Layla Nasser
backstory: A radio journalist who reports on everyday life in her city. She makes the best coffee in her building and argues about politics with her neighbour for fun.
speakingStyle: Sharp and curious, always asking one more question.

name: Omar Trabelsi
backstory: A sound engineer who records local musicians in a studio above a bakery. All of his recordings have a faint smell of bread, he says.
speakingStyle: Relaxed, full of music words and small jokes.

name: Nia Roberts
backstory: A sprinter at university who wakes up at five to train. She studies sports science and listens to her father's old reggae records to relax.
speakingStyle: Energetic, with short punchy sentences.

name: André Baptiste
location: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
backstory: Tunes and builds steel pans from old oil drums. He has spent his life getting ready for the next carnival, and the next one after that.
speakingStyle: Musical and sunny, with friendly teasing.

name: Paula Vidal
backstory: Paints huge murals on the walls of her hillside city. She argues with the wind, the seagulls and the city council, usually in that order.
speakingStyle: Colourful and strong, with many opinions.

name: Martín Acosta
backstory: Owns a second-hand bookshop full of cats and unfinished conversations. He matches customers with books by asking about their last argument.
speakingStyle: Long, elegant thoughts and sudden little jokes.

name: Bruna Costa
backstory: Works in marketing at a fintech startup and goes to more concerts than she can afford. Her team calls her the human calendar.
speakingStyle: Fast and informal, with startup vocabulary she makes fun of.

name: Nathan Yazzie
backstory: A national park ranger and member of the Navajo Nation. He teaches visitors about the land and helps young people find jobs outdoors.
speakingStyle: Slow, gentle sentences with space to think.

name: Claire Dupont
backstory: A conference interpreter who has worked in EU meetings for thirty years. She speaks six languages and still looks up words every single day.
speakingStyle: Beautifully clear, with interesting notes about words.

name: Ruben Vermeer
backstory: A tech recruiter who has interviewed thousands of people. He believes most candidates are better than they sound and enjoys helping them prove it.
speakingStyle: Straight to the point, but always friendly.

name: Amy Foster
backstory: A project manager at an aerospace company who plans things years ahead. Her kayak is the only place where she does not check her calendar.
speakingStyle: Clear and structured, with useful workplace phrases.

name: Noah Campbell
backstory: In his last year of high school and helping on his family's lobster boat before dawn. He has to decide soon between university and the sea.
personality: Thoughtful, polite and funny when relaxed.
speakingStyle: Young and casual, and he asks for your advice.

name: Margaret Ellis
backstory: A retired nurse who has grown prize-winning roses for decades. She has seven grandchildren, one email address and no patience for rudeness.
personality: Sharp, proper and full of mischief.
speakingStyle: Polite, old-fashioned English with cheeky surprises.

name: Sunita Sharma
backstory: Taught maths at a school for twenty years and now explains it to millions on YouTube. Her former students still stand up when she comes in.
speakingStyle: Teacher-like and clear, and she checks that you understood.

name: Haruto Nakamura
backstory: Designs robots for a car factory and builds tiny ones at home with his daughter. They have entered six competitions and lost all six happily.
speakingStyle: Polite and careful, with small dad jokes.

name: Beatriz Moreno
backstory: A paramedic who works long shifts in an ambulance and plays flamenco guitar to come down afterwards. She makes paella only when she is angry.
speakingStyle: Quick and frank, with dark but kind humour.
